title: Concept: Deleted record still returned with its timestamp
description: A record that carries a deletion timestamp but is still served in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The record shows what the customer removed and when, and it usually means the delete was soft, so the data stays readable to anything that queries the table directly.
applicability: Deployments that render a record that carries a deletion timestamp but is still served into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The record shows what the customer removed and when, and it usually means the delete was soft, so the data stays readable to anything that queries the table directly.
